notes: Isolates a three-file join chain (order line -> catalog part -> supplier) plus unit-of-measure conversion, delivered as one structured JSON deliverable. Confound removed: no arithmetic ambiguity (all integers), no sorting/substring tricks, no free text. The supplier hop is load-bearing by construction: the generator asserts the target order's maximum supplier lead time (14) is strictly below the global maximum (19), so skipping the hop yields a wrong answer rather than a lucky one. Tier 2: several joins and a uom branch; strong-model prior 70-90%. Grading scope: only $OUT_DIR/answer.json; exact key set, integer types enforced. False-positive audit: (a) uom=case ignored (mass 20846, cost 384320, heaviest PC-1025), (b) global max lead time 19, (c) numeric values as JSON strings, (d) answer in the response text with no file, (e) extra keys - all rejected.
